input.goal: Crumble up the biscuit and combine with the mixture

sub_goals.text: Gather ingredients and prepare food processor parts.
Attempt to assemble the food processor blade.
Find the correct piece and figure out the assembly.
Wash and dry the center piece of the food processor.
Assemble the food processor blade and plug in the appliance.
Test the food processor and prepare it for use.
Add the first batch of biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the first batch of biscuits.
Add more biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the second batch of biscuits.
Add the remaining biscuits from the first packet and crush them.
Add a second packet of biscuits to the food processor.
Crush the second packet of biscuits.

plan.goal: Crumble up the biscuit and combine with the mixture

events.description: Place the food processor bowl and base on the counter.
events.relevance: Brings the main appliance needed for crushing into the workspace.

events.description: Place a packet of biscuits on the counter.
events.relevance: Brings the ingredient to be crushed into the workspace.

events.description: Try to fit the blade directly into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: Attempts to set up the crushing mechanism.

events.description: Pick up the center spindle piece for the food processor.
events.relevance: Retrieves the missing part required to mount the blade.

events.description: Water runs from the tap while washing the spindle.
events.relevance: Cleans the part before it contacts food.

events.description: Dry the spindle with a towel.
events.relevance: Removes moisture before inserting it into an electrical appliance.

events.description: Insert the spindle and then the blade into the bowl.
events.relevance: Successfully completes the blade assembly.

events.description: Plug the food processor cord into the wall outlet.
events.relevance: Provides power to the appliance.

events.description: The motor whirs briefly as the button is pressed.
events.relevance: Confirms the appliance is assembled correctly and has power.

events.description: Remove the lid from the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: Opens the bowl to allow ingredients to be added.

events.description: Tear open the first packet of biscuits.
events.relevance: Accesses the ingredients.

events.description: Drop a batch of biscuits into the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: Loads the first batch of ingredients to be crushed.

events.description: Place the lid securely onto the food processor bowl.
events.relevance: Secures the bowl so the processor can be turned on safely.

events.description: Loud crushing and motor noises occur as the biscuits are processed.
events.relevance: Indicates the biscuits are being broken down.

events.description: Remove the lid from the bowl again.
events.relevance: Opens the bowl to add more ingredients.

events.description: Drop more biscuits into the bowl.
events.relevance: Loads the next batch.

events.description: Motor noise resumes as the button is pressed to crush the second batch.
events.relevance: Breaks down the newly added biscuits.

events.description: Empty the remaining biscuits from the first packet into the bowl.
events.relevance: Finishes the first packet of ingredients.

events.description: Open a second packet of biscuits.
events.relevance: Accesses more ingredients needed for the recipe.

events.description: Drop biscuits from the second packet into the bowl.
events.relevance: Loads the final batch of ingredients.

events.description: Motor noise sounds as the final batch is crushed.
events.relevance: Completes the crumbling of all biscuits.

relations.ask: What object is being washed under the running water?
relations.answer_hint: The center spindle piece that was just picked up.

relations.ask: What is making the loud crushing noise inside the food processor?
relations.answer_hint: The first batch of biscuits that were just dropped into the bowl.

relations.ask: What is being crushed during this final motor noise?
relations.answer_hint: The biscuits from the second packet that were just dropped into the bowl.

decision_points.why: The person must decide to start assembling the food processor parts to prepare for crushing.
The person realizes a piece is missing after a failed assembly attempt and decides to locate the spindle.
The person decides the spindle needs to be washed before it can be used with food.
The person decides the part is clean and dry enough to proceed with the final assembly and plug it in.
The person decides to test the appliance to ensure it works before committing ingredients to it.
The person decides the machine is ready and initiates the actual food processing task by adding the first batch.
The person decides there are enough biscuits in the bowl to run the first crushing cycle.
The person evaluates the crushed biscuits and decides to add more rather than emptying the bowl.
This is a continuation of the add-and-crush loop, repeating the exact same action as before.
This is still continuing the established loop of adding the remaining biscuits and crushing them.
The person decides that the first packet was not enough and makes the choice to open a completely new packet.
This is a repetition of the crushing action for the newly added biscuits.
The person must decide that all necessary biscuits have been crushed and the crumbling phase of the goal is complete.
